tasks.instructions: 1. **The “Too Much Tension” Check**     **Visual:** A workout photo with small arrows pointing towards the shoulders and jaw.     **Text:**      “Quick tension check 👀      Relax your jaw.      Let your shoulders settle.      Keep breathing.”     **Poll:** “Were you holding extra tension?”      **Options:** “Caught me 😅” / “Feeling relaxed”   2. **Which One Makes an Exercise Harder?**     **Visual:** A photo of someone performing a Pilates exercise, with the question above it.     **Text:**      ��Which can make a Pilates move more challenging?”     **Quiz options:**      A. Moving faster      B. Slowing down with control ✅      C. Holding your breath   3. **Pilates “Cheat Code”**     **Visual:** A cropped workout photo with the tip in a clear text box.     **Text:**      “Feeling the exercise in the wrong place?          Make the movement smaller.      Slow down.      Check your position with your instructor.”     **Small footer:** “If it hurts, pause.”   4. **Pick Your Pilates Challenge**     **Visual:** Two existing workout photos side by side.     **Text:**      “Pick your focus for today’s Pilates class 👇”     **Poll options:**      “Balance ✨” / “Control 💪”   5. **Breathing Challenge**     **Visual:** A calm studio photo with plenty of space around the text.     **Text:**      “Pause before your next set.          Take 3 gentle breaths.      Relax your shoulders.      Breathe at your own pace.”     **Poll:** “How do you feel?”      **Options:** “More relaxed 😌” / “About the same”   6. **Pilates Reality Check**     **Visual:** An existing class photo with the text over a plain, readable background.     **Text:**      “Your Pilates doesn’t have to look perfect.          Move with control.      Take a reset when you need one.      Listen to your body.”     **Emoji slider:** “Needed this reminder?” 💛   7. **You’re the Instructor**     **Visual:** A Pilates exercise photo with a small label: “Imagine this scenario”.     **Text:**      “You’re the instructor 👀          Someone is rushing and losing control.      What would you correct first?”     **Quiz options:**      A. Their speed ✅      B. Their outfit      C. Their rep count     **Designer note:** Don’t label the person in the photo as doing the exercise incorrectly.   8. **Don’t Count Every Rep the Same**     **Visual:** A clear workout photo with “Make every rep count” in large text.     **Text:**      “Make every rep count.          Keep your pace steady.      Use a range you can control.      Pay attention to the return.”     **Poll:** “What’s your focus today?”      **Options:** “Steady pace” / “Better control”
